        whether the exception was raised while routing, in a middleware
        method, in a responder, or while rendering the response body. This is
        useful for, e.g., logging exceptions or sending them to an error
        tracker.

        The reporter is invoked before the matching error handler (if any).
        Exceptions raised by an error handler, by the error serializer, or
        when the response cannot be started are reported too. However, an
        exception that is merely re-raised by its own error handler is not
        reported a second time.

        Note:

            the previous one. The reporter is always a regular (synchronous)
            callable, in both WSGI and ASGI apps.

            def my_reporter(req, ex, params, handled):
                pass

                error handler matches the exception type, and ``False`` when
                the exception is going to propagate to the app server.

        .. versionadded:: 4.2
        """
        self._error_reporter = reporter
